items.name: Command
items.summary: An owned description of a command to execute with a [`CommandExecutor`].

methods.name: arg
methods.signature: fn arg(&mut self, argument: impl Into<String>) -> &mut Self
methods.summary: Adds an argument to the command.

methods.name: args
methods.signature: fn args<I, S>(&mut self, arguments: I) -> &mut Self where I: IntoIterator<Item = S>, S: Into<String>
methods.summary: Adds multiple arguments to the command.

methods.name: current_dir
methods.signature: fn current_dir(&mut self, directory: impl AsRef<SystemPath>) -> &mut Self
methods.summary: Sets the working directory for the command.

methods.name: env
methods.signature: fn env(&mut self, name: impl Into<String>, value: impl Into<String>) -> &mut Self
methods.summary: Sets an environment variable for the command.

methods.name: env_clear
methods.summary: Clears the inherited environment and any variables previously set on this command.

methods.name: env_remove
methods.signature: fn env_remove(&mut self, name: impl Into<String>) -> &mut Self
methods.summary: Removes an environment variable from the command.

methods.name: get_args
methods.summary: Returns the arguments passed to the executable.

methods.name: get_current_dir
methods.summary: Returns the command's working directory, if explicitly configured.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a command for the given executable.

methods.name: dyn_clone
methods.summary: Creates an owned executor that can be moved to another thread.

methods.name: execute
methods.summary: Runs a command and captures its standard output and standard error.
